title: Full Mockup Product Parity and Navigation Binding
goal: Port the complete product language from wizard_mockup.html, ui_mockup.html, and cinema_mockup.html into the live operator console, including missing screens, menu items, wizard steps, route bindings, and styling for all screens not explicitly drawn in the mockups.
scope: Create one coherent operator UI where the mockups are the product design authority. Inventory every mockup screen and interactive entrypoint, restore missing navigation items, add the Live/Autonomous Agents view, align wizard steps 1-4, align Mission Control, Attack Map, Findings, Reports, Settings, History, Packs, Problems, Dashboard, Evidence Replay, and Explorer to the same design language, strengthen the currently sparse Dashboard into a true command center in that same language, and ensure buttons navigate or execute existing safe actions instead of being decorative.
generation_reason: The previous exact mockup port was too narrow and only covered a few surfaces. The operator explicitly authorized deviating from the currently promoted backlog task because the whole product must be consistent with the root mockups and all missing menu items/screens must be included and wired.

constraints.active_task_gate: This task is operator-escalated and may supersede the currently promoted backlog-86 task for UI parity repair.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: UI/product parity and safe route binding only. Do not add new offensive runtime behavior, new backend mutation semantics, pack-gate bypasses, hidden agents, or uncontrolled tool execution.

success_criteria: All root mockup screens are inventoried and mapped to live screens or explicitly documented as product-truth deviations.
Sidebar includes all mockup menu items: New Mission, Intake, Mission Control, Attack Map, Findings, Reports, History, Packs, Settings, plus active-run context.
Bottom screen switcher includes Intake, Mission Control, Agents, Findings, Reports, and Settings and navigates correctly.
Wizard steps 1-4 match the wizard mockup language: Choose, Target, Preview, Launch.
Mission Control includes mockup-style Scan Map, Tasks, Findings pulse, AI Signal, View Agents, Kill Run, View Findings, and Cinema Mode actions bound to existing state/actions.
A Live/Autonomous Agents screen exists and renders real task/proposal-derived cards when available, with safe empty-state fallback.
Dashboard becomes a mockup-consistent command center with active run, agent status, risk, open findings/problems, upcoming scans/retests, report readiness, setup/readiness, and quick actions.
Attack Map, Findings, Reports, Settings, History, Packs, Problems, Dashboard, Evidence Replay, and Explorer share the same shell, cards, chips, toolbar, type, radius, and spacing language.
No decorative-only controls remain for key mockup buttons: visible buttons either navigate, open an existing dialog, trigger an existing safe action, or show a truthful disabled state.
Desktop and mobile/narrow screenshots show no incoherent overlap or horizontal overflow.
Fast UI tests cover the newly restored navigation and mockup route binding.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding bypasses
new live-target actions beyond existing safe/local/authorized flows

acceptance_criteria: Browser acceptance verifies all primary sidebar and bottom-nav routes.

Browser acceptance captures wizard step 1-4, Mission Control, Agents, Attack Map, Findings, Reports, Settings, History, Packs, Dashboard, Problems, Evidence Replay, and Explorer screenshots where relevant.
Buttons from the mockups are either functionally bound or truthfully disabled with existing state.
No full slow operator-console monolith is required unless explicitly requested by the operator.

before_promotion: Operator explicitly authorized superseding the current next task to repair full mockup parity.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with full mockup parity implementation and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the new UI product truth and remaining risks.
Promote exactly one next task into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: New backend endpoints unless required to read existing data safely.
Changing pack approval or deployment semantics.
Claiming full security feature support without safe-run evidence.
